body:
Demands submission from the adventurers and attacks Akarian Irenhour and Saray with weapons of flame.

Recorded role and choices

During the confrontation on 23 April 2025, Vigor claims that the company’s grief feeds his power and offers to use their loyalty in his vengeance. Those are his assertions, not independently established metaphysical rules. The visible encounter shows him ordering other creatures to stand down, then striking Akarian and Saray with a fiery whip and sword. His final defeat or later status is not established by these selected actor messages.
